summary.text: Christian Martin is the Democratic candidate for Alabama House of Representatives District 16 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Bryan Brinyark (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is running to protect rural hospitals, expand health insurance access and cut taxes on working people.

paragraphs.text: Christian Martin graduated from Tuscaloosa High School, and his career experience includes working as an activist.
The Democratic primary for District 16 was canceled, and he advanced to the general election without appearing on a primary ballot.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Martin said his priorities include Medicaid expansion and maternal healthcare, cutting the sales tax by two percentage points, abolishing the grocery tax, and ending income tax on overtime and tips.
He also said he would require public rate hearings for utilities and ban utilities from having lobbyists or making campaign donations.
He named labor rights, healthcare and tax policy as the policy areas he is most passionate about.
